narrative.overview:
A deep navy stage where the product works in plain sight. The page is dark and calm, never flat black, so that the things that are alive (the agent console, the film, the reel, the live chat) carry the light. Cyan is the colour of the agent itself: it marks the one action to take, the live state and the thin lines that connect things, and nothing else. The craft bar is the category standard at full finish (linear.app, sierra.ai, decagon.ai): restrained, product-led, legible.

Surfaces are glass cards floating over a slow aurora: three blurred fields of cyan, blue and indigo fixed behind every page, drifting over a 48-second cycle. Depth comes from translucency, a hairline top edge and long, low, black ambient shadows, never from colour fills. Motion is part of the world: content rises once as it enters, the film pins and grows as you scroll, the reel follows the video, and navigating between the home and a service page morphs the pillar title and icon in place.

This world is a user-pinned hybrid: the production site's rich components inside the multi-page prototype's restraint. It explicitly refuses production's noise (particles, canvas beams, moving lines and dots, marquee, uppercase black headings). The one ambient layer it keeps is the slow aurora, chosen by the owner on 20 Oct 2026 because flat black read as too basic.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy ground with three greyscale surfaces and hairline white borders.
One accent, cyan, used as a signal and never as a field.
Archivo heavy, slightly condensed, sentence case, tight negative tracking; Inter for everything you read.
Glass cards (20px radius) with a cursor-following cyan glow on hover.
Motion that explains: expo-out reveals once, scroll-pinned film, video-synced reel, shared-element page transitions.
Illustrative data is always labelled; real figures come from one monthly source.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Field Rule
rules.body: Cyan is an accent: primary action, icon tiles, live state, progress and connecting lines. It is never a full-bleed or section background (owner decision, 19 Oct 2026). The largest permitted cyan area is a button or the film's "Ver con sonido" control.

rules.name: The One Cyan Action Rule
rules.body: A cyan-filled button always means one thing: request the free diagnosis (the nav CTA and the hero CTA are the same action). Every other action uses the quiet (outlined) or light button.

rules.name: The One Aurora Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere comes only from the single aurora layer (body::before, fixed, behind everything, 48 s drift, still under reduced motion). No per-section glows, second animated layer, particles, lines or dots. Never flat black: the ground is navy.
rules.section: Atmosphere comes only from the single aurora layer (body::before, fixed, behind everything, 48 s drift, still under reduced motion). No per-section glows, second animated layer, particles, lines or dots. Never flat black: the ground is navy.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case in Archivo 800 to 850 with negative tracking. No uppercase headings, no tracked-out labels above headings. The only uppercase, tracked text in the system is the "SOLUTIONS" line of the logo lockup, which is a brand asset.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any figure that can change (monthly numbers, money in demos) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Lift By Light Rule
rules.body: A card responds to the pointer with light, not movement: its border warms to cyan at 32% and the cursor glow fades in. Cards do not jump or scale on hover.

dos: Do keep the ground at Navy Ink with the single slow aurora as the only atmosphere, and mark at most one key word per heading in cyan.
Do use Agent Cyan for the diagnosis action, icon tiles, live state, progress and lines, and Cyan Ink for anything sitting on it.
Do set headings in Archivo 800 to 850, sentence case, negative tracking, balanced wrap.
Do build containers as glass cards: 20px radius, hairline glass border, inset top highlight, long soft black drop, cursor glow on hover.

Do use the expo-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for reveals, entrances and transitions; reveal content once, staggered by 80ms, and enter the first viewport with the CSS rise (110ms stagger) so it never waits on JavaScript.
Do keep everything visible without JavaScript and with reduced motion: reveals, rise, film pin and reel sync switch off, and muted loops keep their poster.
Do label every illustrative video or example figure with the dashed demo tag, and pull real results from the single monthly figures source, naming the month.
Do write copy without the em dash character.
donts: Don't use cyan as a full-bleed, section or hero background.
Don't set headings in uppercase or Archivo black, and don't put tracked uppercase labels above headings.
Don't add particles, aurora layers, canvas beams, marquees or per-section glows.
Don't move or scale cards on hover; respond with border colour and the cursor glow.
Don't put video behind a modal; it plays inline.
Don't use hard, offset or coloured drop shadows on surfaces.
Don't show an unlabelled demo number or a business figure without a source.
